  About this tool

  Version       1.4.0
  Template set  1.4.0, the catalog built into this version, which new plans record

  Places this tool uses

  State home    /home/sam/.local/state/obk
                The tool reads and writes it.
                Holds the list of your plans, and the sessions and imports of your onboarding.
                Chosen as the default for this system. Set OBK_HOME to choose another.

  Plan list     /home/sam/.local/state/obk/plans.txt
                The tool reads and writes it.
                Holds the path of each plan you opened or created here.

  Plan folder   the folder of each plan you open
                The tool reads and writes it.
                Holds the plan file.

  Records root  /work
                The tool reads and writes it.
                Holds your onboarding record.
